name: Destiny Marie Love
reason: Work is sold mainly on nervous-system healing: most of her YouTube titles promise to heal or reset the nervous system or vagus nerve or calm stress, her sessions page lists anxiety and trauma, and both books are framed on trauma or menstrual pain and hormones, so the channel as a whole is condition-led (judgement call: a few voice, mantra and purpose practices and her Udemy voice courses would pass on their own).
